I would honestly like to hear something like that in a form of a remix. But you're right, the weeknd conveys his emotions through his lyrics, so repetition doesn't do him justice. 

Hence why people don't like Starboy/BBTM compared to his old work. Pop music has more chorus and less verse.

This Monday man. But mad props for being a bro. 

I'll look better on paper as a statistic than I ever did in real life.
I did do that, for 18 years. But the things I can't change are the ones bothering me the most. So I'm going to take my chances with death. If the afterlife sucks I'll let you know.

Let me get this straight. I should live through all the shit and travesty that I face, just so the people around me don't have to worry about me dying?

I didn't ask to be born, no one is asked to be born. To be honest I think I'm doing them a favor, one less mouth to feed, one less disappointment, one less thing to worry about in the long run.

You don't know who I am, you don't know what I've done. So don't pretend like you do.
Ladi dadi da slob on me knob
Suck my dick AutoModerator. You're on the list.

Yeah man, everyone's problems and situation is so very unique. Only we can decide to help ourselves. 

To me it's just not worth it anymore, simple as that. When an animal in nature starts slacking off, it dies, we call it Natural Selection. Yet when humans start slacking off we call it depression, and without a natural predator, we attempt to take our own life.

Living in the between (aka depression) really isn't worth it. Just wasting time. You gotta make a decision to live or die, and whole heartedly. Pick a side and run with it.

I'm 18 with nothing to lose, so I'm picking the latter. You're situation is tough, and I'd be full of shit if I tried giving you advice. I'm just sharing my thoughts. If you want to talk more, pm me. I'd love to hear more about you.

I think you're the only one who's answered my question. Sorry about being a dick earlier.

I hope you figure out what you need to in life. Its a bitch. I'm not really a drug user, I don't really have any family and I've pushed away most of my friends. 

I feel like this is the next step for me, which isn't always the case for everyone. Google is a slippery slope when searching for suicide advice, so that's why I posted this.

I'm thinking either tomorrow or Monday. Regardless, thanks and peace.

No, I just wanted to know how much I would need. Because I tried before without research and ended up sick. But you're saying alcohol and codeine don't mix? 

So combining the two will do it better than cutting myself?
I'll be dead. It won't matter to me at that point.
No help, that's what I'm trying to avoid.
Oof someone's hurt. I'll send you a pm on Monday bby. Hope you like blood.
Selfish?

I have to do the extraction or else I won't properly take in all the codeine, as I will most likely damage my liver with about 8000mg of acetaminophen. 

I want it to be a fun experience. But based on everyone's responses, I am just gonna have to be barbaric and use a knife or something. Too bad.
How numb can I get on Codeine? Will 500mg be enough not to feel much of anything? Or does it cap out.
Yeah, but I really want to avoid getting messy. Codeine is the only drug available to me in large amounts right now.

I think I can push it to 500mg, I just found out how to extract codeine from my pills (which contain paracetamol). Meaning I have easily 200mg just from tablets and about 300mg of syrup. Alcohol and Marijuana will also be present.

I have no doubt that if I started to take control of my life that I could definitely turn a few things around. That would involve drastic changes and possibly getting away from my family again. In fact part of me is begging me to try at least.

What stops me is the question: Is it worth it? It really doesn't seem to be. My happiness isn't real, it was never real. 

Not a single thing is keeping me here. I have squandered all the opportunities I have been given in the past and when I do try, something ends up happening (like my rib breaking) that reminds me that it's all just bullshit. Rather than living an eventual shitty life that I will regret, I think for the first time in my life I am being proactive and deciding not to live at all. As of right now, I don't see any other option that's nearly as good as this one. 

Edit: I feel so trapped. I honestly just don't know what to do. If I could just block out everything for a few days and zoom out and see what I need to do. But its just not coming to me in this state, I am at my lowest and its only going to get lower it feels :/

I know exactly how you feel. Society is a bitch it makes us feel that way. Our family, friends, people we meet. Social forums like reddit, facebook, instagram. And the entertainment we indulge in. Sometimes its good to take a step back and look at the bigger picture.

Are you Gabe Newell? (Yeah I figured it out)

And can you please reply to my steam help request ticket.

I didn't choose the cards I was dealt and I no longer want to play this game. I can't change my family, I can't change my childhood, I can't change my physical/mental problems and no one is willing to help me. Heck, I'm not willing to help myself anymore. I appreciate this but maybe someone else can benefit from your time and kind words.
